C0248.title: Man Sentenced in Shaoxing for Selling Pirated Music Bundled on USB Drives
C0248.summary: In 2022, Xinchang police disclosed an online copyright infringement case. Wang operated an online store and copied unauthorized music works onto USB drives and SD cards for sale, selling more than 4,000 infringing products with sales exceeding RMB 210,000. Police arrested Wang, Qiu, Yao, and others. Xinchang Court convicted Wang of copyright infringement, sentenced him to three years in prison suspended for four years, and imposed an RMB 60,000 fine.
